cc:Work.dc:description: Policy degradation. The required spacing rises from 1367.5 to 3617.5 m, which the follower can only achieve by falling behind. The two controllers do not aim at the same quantity: the baseline targets S(F, v_F) at the follower's instantaneous speed, which falls as the follower slows, so it settles where its own moving target meets the gap. It spends the full braking limit doing so and still ends 125 m short. The reference plans the whole speed profile from the displacement it must accumulate, lands on the target exactly, and uses six times less braking.
